load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained diffusers model from the huggingface hub or a local directory using ModelMixin.from_pretrained
save_model_pretrained: save a diffusers model and its configuration to a directory using ModelMixin.save_pretrained
enable_gradient_checkpointing: enable gradient checkpointing on a diffusers model to reduce memory usage during training
enable_xformers_attention: enable xformers memory efficient attention on a diffusers model for lower GPU memory usage
enable_layerwise_casting: enable layerwise casting on a diffusers model to reduce memory footprint by casting weights to lower precision
